probes.question: Which two substances act as cryoprotectants in wood frogs?
True or false: a frozen wood frog has no detectable heartbeat.

image.alt: A wood frog with a dark eye mask resting among brown pine needles and leaf litter.

body.question: Which animal can tolerate the freezing of its blood and other tissues?
body.reveal: Wood frogs can tolerate the freezing of their blood and other tissues. When frozen, they have no detectable vital signs: no heartbeat, breathing, blood circulation, muscle movement, or detectable brain activity. Urea and glucose act as cryoprotectants to limit the amount of ice that forms.
